title: Binary Tree: Pre-order Traversal
summary: Walk a binary search tree recursively: visit the node first, then the left subtree, then the right subtree. Watch the call stack grow and shrink.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Values to insert (in order)
inputs.note: They are inserted into a binary search tree first: smaller values go left, others go right.

practice.note: The tree arrives as `root` (None or null when empty), built by inserting the values one at a time into a binary search tree (smaller goes left, equal or larger goes right). A TreeNode has `val`, `left` and `right`. Return the pre-order traversal as a list: node, left subtree, right subtree.
